name: GelatOK
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to GelatOK in Kufstein!**

Indulge in the finest **Gelato** and **Eis** in the heart of **Tirol**, just a short drive from **Innsbruck**. Our authentic Italian-inspired flavors are crafted with love, using only the freshest ingredients.

Try our signature **Kaiserschmarrn**-flavored gelato or enjoy a classic **Vanille** or **Schoko** treat. Whether you're exploring the charming old town of **Kufstein**, visiting the mighty **Kufsteiner Festungsberg**, or taking a scenic stroll along the **Inn**, a stop at GelatOK is the perfect way to refresh and delight your taste buds.

**Come by and taste the difference!** 🍦
